# Pop'n Bloom Events

> Pop'n Bloom Events is a Metro Vancouver, British Columbia event styling studio specializing in custom balloon decor, event backdrops, and vintage video guestbook rentals.

## Services
- Balloon decor and backdrops: organic garlands, arches, personalized panels, florals, props, and coordinated event styling.
- Vintage video guestbook: a decorated wall-telephone experience that records heartfelt video messages from guests.

## Service area
Metro Vancouver, including Vancouver, Burnaby, Richmond, Surrey, Coquitlam, New Westminster, Delta, and Langley.
